Selecting country time zone from a searchable dropdown of IANA time zone names , instead of a static UTC offset list, So that the system automatically handles Daylight Saving Time changes without requiring manual updates.

As a system, when a date/time is displayed or processed, I want the correct local time to be calculated using the IANA time zone associated with the country, So that all times reflect the current DST rules without manual intervention.
As a system administrator, I want to migrate existing country records from static UTC offsets to IANA time zone names, So that the system is fully updated without data loss.
